annotation.title_clean: B.C. Reg. 63/2024 – Order in Council 147/2024 (Motor Vehicle Amendment Act, 2023 brought into force; automated vehicle offences and fines)
annotation.title_en: B.C. Reg. 63/2024 – Order in Council 147/2024 (Motor Vehicle Amendment Act, 2023 brought into force; automated vehicle offences and fines)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of British Columbia (Lieutenant Governor in Council; Minister of Transportation and Infrastructure)
annotation.venue: The British Columbia Gazette, Part II
annotation.summary_en: British Columbia regulation, effective April 5, 2024, bringing into force section 35 of the Motor Vehicle Amendment Act, 2023 and amending the Motor Vehicle Act Regulations and the fines regulation to create violation ticket offences, with fines, for driving or permitting driving of Level 3, 4 or 5 automated vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Brings section 35 of the Motor Vehicle Amendment Act, 2023 into force on April 5, 2024
Creates offences under section 303.2 for driving or permitting driving of Level 3, 4 and 5 automated vehicles
Adds the offences to the Motor Vehicle Act Regulations violation ticket schedule
Sets fines of $320 base amount (varying $295 to $368 by column) in the Violation Ticket Administration and Fines Regulation
